historical_sanity_anchor: Historical Taiho remained in intensive Lingga carrier training through April/early May after becoming Ozawa flagship on 15 Apr. Branch earlier completion plus larger surviving cadre accelerates the curve, but does not erase the separate ship/deck/air-group integration clock.

still_below_veteran_core: repeat launch/recovery rhythm at sustained tempo

personnel_effect: Taiho is easier to activate because veteran seed cadres and secondary-carrier qualification capacity exist. Acceleration is mostly in leader density, landing qualification and deck-team learning; it does not require hollowing out the four veteran carriers.
basing: Continue Davao-Celebes/Tarakan axis rotation and sea exercises; no Palau forward basing.
